entries.title: A card tells you when another computer needs an update
entries.body: When a computer that runs work for you is on an older Firstmate than this one, a card now asks you to update it, with the two versions and what the gap means for its work. Update it opens Settings → Devices and updates it at once. Not now keeps the card away until a version changes, and it goes by itself once that computer is up to date.

picture.alt: An Attention card titled Update Firstmate on Running as Builder, naming both versions, with Not now and Update it
